findings.verified: Issue #3469 reports a reviewer dispatched on R1 whose late BLOCK arrived after parent R2/R3 and a newer R3 approval without a stale marker. The repository owner later confirmed an equal-submitted-hash partial fix was insufficient when runtime did not derive/freeze canonical source identity. Merged PR #3631 derives canonical source snapshot identity, persists dispatch/delivery provenance, classifies current/stale_review_delivery/invalid_provenance, excludes stale/invalid deliveries from current gates, and includes a regression where an R1 delivery after source advancement is stale.
findings.scope: Strong first-party issue+merged-code/test evidence for the Gajae Code review/gate path. It is not a general empirical proof that arbitrary superseded child results mutate a newer parent attempt, and the verifier did not independently execute the reported 236-test suite.

findings.verified: Open issue #1084 reports detectCompleted()/artifactOutputExists() treating path existence/glob match as completion, so an interrupted empty/partial artifact can be reported done and skipped on resume. Open PR #1098 changes completion to reject empty/whitespace/comment-only output and reports targeted tests.
findings.material_scope_correction: The candidate predicate is not semantic completeness. Its own patch/release note says heading-only or other partially written artifacts may still be treated complete; the tests explicitly accept '# Proposal' as complete. PR #1098 remains open and unmerged.
findings.scope: Reporter-scoped bug evidence plus unmerged candidate fix; no merged guarantee.

findings.verified: Issue #36529 reports a matched A/B on Windows Desktop / bundled CLI 0.146.0-alpha.9.2 where one internal send with recipient host omitted persists once locally and again through an active Remote Control route under a different message ID; explicit hostId=local and inactive remote-view conditions remove the duplicate in the reporter's setup.
findings.scope: Open reporter evidence for duplicate message persistence in the stated environment. It does not establish maintainer-confirmed root cause/fix, canonical provider-wide logical-message identity, or duplication of an external downstream side effect.

findings.verified: Issue #46934 reports stale resume_pending sessions that can preserve old transcript context. Merged PR #56264 identifies generic updated_at as unsuitable because ordinary messages refresh it, moves the gate to last_resume_marked_at, and includes matched tests for fresh resume, stale resume mark with fresh generic updated_at, and <=0 opt-out.
findings.scope: Exact Hermes session freshness mechanism. It is evidence that a causal recovery marker can be safer than a generic mutable timestamp in this path, not a general recommendation that wall-clock age alone is sufficient for recovery authority.

findings.verified: Merged PR #44454 had already reframed compaction summaries as historical/reference-only and removed the topic-consistency carveout. Issue #80622 then reports a completed assistant stop followed by a synthetic 32,052-character role=user reference handoff with no later human ask; that handoff drove new tool calls and stale work. Merged PR #81070 adds provenance predicates and guards so a sole synthetic handoff cannot become the active user turn, while restoring a pending real user ask and preserving a mid-tool-loop exception.
findings.scope: Strong regression evidence that textual reference-only framing alone did not control action authority in this Hermes orchestration path. It does not imply prompt framing is universally irrelevant.

findings.verified: Open issue #57056 reports a webhook-only EKS deployment where SIGTERM/restart correctly marks and schedules resume_pending, but the empty-message resume guidance tells the model to report restoration/ask the user and skip unfinished history; the resumed turn makes one API call, stops with no tools, and produces no downstream output. Open PR #57323 introduces platform-aware non-interactive guidance and five isolated tests.
findings.material_scope_correction: PR #57323 explicitly states the load-bearing manual webhook-only reproduction had not yet been run by the PR author. It remains open/unmerged, and its own comments preserve the separate ambiguity/idempotency problem for effects that may already have landed.
findings.scope: Reporter-scoped failure plus unmerged code/test candidate; no merged or live-reproduction recovery guarantee.

cross_leaf_conclusions: FE-422, FE-425 and FE-426 each have a merged code-level repair with matched regression logic, but each remains subsystem-scoped.
FE-423, FE-424 and FE-427 remain open evidence; do not promote their proposed fixes or inferred root causes to current guarantees.

Across these examples, a recurring fail-closed distinction is between a superficial carrier signal (file exists, message role/id, generic timestamp, scheduled resume) and a causal authority/completion witness (canonical source snapshot, semantic completion contract, user origin, causal recovery marker, platform-appropriate continuation plus effect recovery).
That recurrence is a design pattern synthesis across separately scoped sources, not a measured universal failure rate.

semantic completeness for non-empty partially written OpenSpec artifacts

Hermes freshness behavior outside the merged gateway/session path

exact_next_verification: Do not repeat FE-422..FE-427 unless source status or implementation changes materially.
Prefer a maintainer-confirmed real superseded parent/run N late child result that mutates N+1, then compare exact generation/task-token fencing with a matched fix.
Revisit OpenSpec #1084/#1098 only on merge/closure or a stronger terminal artifact completion witness beyond nonblank content.
Revisit Codex #36529 only on maintainer-confirmed resolution or an independent route-level logical-message dedupe control.
Revisit Hermes #57056/#57323 only on merged resolution plus a live non-interactive recovery witness that also separates already-landed-effect ambiguity from remaining-work continuation.
Otherwise rotate to another current assignment-bound Phase-1 failure state transition with primary source/test evidence.
